concept.title: Browsing menus are generated
concept.shortdesc: A familiar menu of categories is still offered, generated from the dimensions, and people choose which menu suits them.

conbody.p: A familiar menu of categories is still available. It is generated from the dimensions, so nothing has to be filed twice. Each such menu is called a lens.

ul.li: What is on offer, for people who know what they want, such as “a yoga class” or “a food bank”
What it helps with, for people starting from a problem, such as “help with money worries”

conbody.p: A person can switch between them without losing the place, age or cost they have already chosen.
